title: 实现预占释放承诺实际转换
permissions_impact: Guarded release-history reads require current ledger scope/field authority and source/role rechecks. No user grants, public API or business write entry is added; release evidence controllers still deny writes.
migration_impact: Adds6 release scope columns: fiscal_year, budget_subject, funding_source, project, period_start, period_end; requires indexed budget_subject. Roots/events unchanged. Controlled migration is required before new guarded reads; investigate unexpected old evidence rather than backfill. No server connection or migration.
rollback_plan: Before release business writes exist, revert readers and preserve empty expanded storage. Never delete valid evidence; once release facts exist, stop all writers/workers and retain compatible full-history reads under ADR0037.
security_impact: Private release history reads require the existing shared source/budget guard and current ledger role, field and organization checks before and after evidence reads. Immutable first-event roots are retained. Every current tail is reconstructed from an independently stored release confirmation/decision, bound original intent, full budget key, source snapshot, exact amount, actor, time and predecessor. Scope discovery plus reverse-parent scans detect orphan or cross-scope decisions, including missing whole roots/events; per-parent counts and bounded complete reads reject truncation, missing confirmations and changed chains. Current native sources are re-read; only nonfinancial progression is accepted after original authorization checks. Any outer verification failure poisons the guard and requires a full rollback. The six added scope columns are compared to the private intent snapshot; physical InnoDB, scope/parent indexes and unique successor keys are mandatory. No new user grants, hooks or public APIs are added. The release evidence controller still rejects all writes. Existing initial/renewed posting candidates remain behind their default-disabled flags. Proof and private payload handling remain unchanged. Synthetic native tests do not prove actual human approval, noncooperating writers, deleted evidence, hospital rules or capacity. Unexpected old rows are investigated, never auto-rewritten into valid authorization.
test_plan: Run613 expected pure tests and all local quality checks. Two added checks cover frozen-root tail source binding and native date/scope projection.

Run22 native authorization history cases including8 new release cases: full/renewed progressed roots; missing event/decision/confirmation; scope mismatch; orphan decision without root/event;101st-root batching and overflow.

Run32 native budget/source structure cases;11 strict material reservation cases;2 release storage migration cases and2 actual-source original/renewed posting regressions:69 focused native cases total.

New native release history cases use real budget guards and connection-private synthetic tables with source/access readers substituted. They do not prove a human financial release, all writer fencing or hospital load.

Verify6 new scope columns, reservation/company/budget_subject indexes and physical unique successors before private evidence reads. No migration or automatic evidence backfill on the maintained server.
